wv.offen: This issue is already covered by an outstanding commitment. Fulfil it before seeking applause for another promise.
wv.grenze: This national policy has already reached its limit or been fully enacted. It cannot create a new campaign promise.
wv.gebucht: Promised: {name}, national target {ziel}, by {datum}. No law has been enacted and no funding allocated by this promise.
wv.nachfolgerGebucht: Campaigned for your successor: {name}. This creates no new personal pledge in your ending term.
wv.hinweis: Choose an issue and review the commitment. Political applause comes immediately; delivery still requires funding and legislation.
wv.nachfolger: You are campaigning for your successor. The existing game creates no new personal pledge in your ending term; the legislative estimate below is for reference.
wv.beschluss: The fixed national target is binding. A sufficient nationwide enactment fulfils the legislative pledge; implementation follows later. Merely introducing a bill is not enough.
wv.vertrauen: Government trust: {n} index points. Group reactions are also index points, not guaranteed votes.
wv.erreicht: The promised national target has already been enacted. Implementation may still take time.
wv.gesetzPreis: A new bill today: {pk} political capital and {auf} attention. Annual modelled burden versus today: {bip} percentage points of GDP ({geld} bn TRY). Implementation after passage: {monate, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}.
wv.finanzierung: The promise does not book these amounts. Positive amounts mean additional spending or lost revenue; offsetting funding is not automatic.
wv.regional: Already under debate: regional bill, target {ziel}.
wv.laufend: Already under debate: nationwide bill, target {ziel}.
wv.deckt: If passed, it covers the pledge; its vote forecast follows below.
wv.decktNicht: It does not fulfil this pledge. The forecast below refers only to this existing bill.
wv.beratung: If you introduce a sufficient bill today, the existing deliberation rule extends the deadline to at least {datum}. The promise alone does not extend it.
wv.gesetzOeffnen: Open legislation at the promised target
wv.bedingt: Today’s situation: costs and majorities may change before introduction. Agreements, expiring support and further crises still matter.
